title: Salesforce and Anthropic team up, and 100+ companies call for defences against rogue AI
excerpt: Salesforce and Anthropic announced Claudeforce, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and more than 100 companies called for action on rogue AI, and Google released Gemini speech-to-text.

items.t: Salesforce announced a partnership with Anthropic called Claudeforce. CNBC reported that Salesforce's chief executive was responding to concerns about a "SaaSpocalypse", a term for concerns about AI disrupting software companies. Our reading: the worry is that AI agents could undercut traditional business software.

items.h: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and 100 other companies call for action on rogue AI
items.t: TechCrunch reported that OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and 100 other companies called for action to defend against rogue AI.
Ars Technica reported that Google announced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for AI-powered speech-to-text. Good transcription is the first step for turning meetings and voice notes into action lists.

items.h: Gemini Enterprise comes to financial services and law firms
items.t: Google announced Gemini Enterprise for Financial Services, and Reuters reported it expanded its Gemini Enterprise platform for law firms and lawyers.

water.t: OpenAI published a post titled "Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX". When a rival buys a tool many developers rely on, expect companies to rethink which tools they depend on.

means.t: AI is moving into the CRM. Learn the basics of your company's customer tool now, since the people who can brief AI agents inside it will be valuable.
Use speech-to-text on your next planning meeting. Ask the AI for decisions, owners and deadlines in a table, then check it against what you remember.
If a tool is vital to your work, keep a plan B. Ownership and policies change fast.

prompt: Here is the transcript of my meeting: [paste]. Give me (1) a five-line summary, (2) decisions made, (3) action items as a table with owner and deadline ("not stated" where missing), (4) open questions, and (5) a short WhatsApp message I can send to the group. Use only what is in the transcript.

reads.h: I Let Google's Personal Intelligence Access My Life, and It's a Huge Help
Automated researchers can reliably mitigate alignment failures
